build_tfds_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset using the tfds build CLI command with dataset name and optional version
build_tfds_multiple_datasets: build multiple TensorFlow datasets in a single tfds build CLI call
build_tfds_with_config: build a TensorFlow dataset with specific config using --config or --config_idx flags
build_tfds_download_only: download only TensorFlow dataset files without generating tf-records using --download_only flag
build_tfds_with_download_config: build a TensorFlow dataset with custom download config including manual_dir and extract_dir
